title: Every console page load by a non-admin logs ~16 "[Security] Access denied" WARN lines: the header activity feed's `GET /api/v1/data/sys_activity` fans out to objects the caller cannot read and logs each refusal
body:
Filing gate ①: a defect with a public door, measured.
`reach:` `GET /api/v1/data/sys_activity?top=20&sort=-timestamp` (the console header's activity feed) as any non-admin.
Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`session_01BCDqr1DqnQjEh5jA9gGkUG`) from objectstack-ai/hotcrm's v18 test pass (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2093, finding 04). ⛔ Not a claim. File-at-destination, for triage.
Reader: the objectstack triage seat.
Dedupe: semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectstack, all states, "sys_activity read logs Access denied warnings for every object it skips, log flood on every page load" → 1 hit, #20833 (closed: sys_activity's parent-record read gate), which is a different defect.

## What happens (`@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.0, the HotCRM app, fresh database)

Sign in as `sales.manager` and open `/_console/home` or any record page. The header activity feed calls `GET /api/v1/data/sys_activity?top=20&sort=-timestamp`, which answers `200`. Replaying only that GET adds **16 WARN lines** to the server log:
- `Access denied: operation 'find' on object` for `sys_record_share`, `sys_email`, `sys_approval_action`, `sys_approval_approver`, `sys_approval_request`, `sys_user_position`, `sys_sharing_rule`, …;
- plus `'sys_migration' requires capability [manage_platform_settings]`.

The dev isolated it by replaying each GET of a lead record page: only the `sys_activity` call produced denials.

**What a customer sees:** nothing in the UI. Operations see their logs flooded on every page view by every non-admin, which buries real access denials.

Screenshot (the UI surface; the evidence is the log counts above): [04-activity-feed-access-denied-log-flood.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/54fbfcbc9b8c21966f4d9d859e1ec665b1dd28d7/qa/2026-10-13-v18-pass/04-activity-feed-access-denied-log-flood.png).

## Ask

The activity read scopes itself to the objects the caller can read, without logging a denial for each object it skips. An expected, silent skip is not an access attempt.
